commands.name: CreateFaultTagDraft
steps: outside lock preview each RMA open return obligation/current selected physical unit and submitted-membership conflicts
inside UoW allocate fault_tag_id and non-reusable FT-########
insert receipt/tag/created event/current projection
insert each currently eligible draft membership with exact physical consequence and typed physical unit
audit and commit
rules: draft may temporarily have zero members
pickup location is origin, never warehouse destination

commands.name: UpdateFaultTagDraft
steps: inside UoW require current projection=draft and no accepted real submission authority
revalidate each added obligation/unit/consequence and current exclusivity
pickup method requires/retains one valid pickup-origin location before submission but draft may be incomplete during editing
insert receipt; update draft logistics and add/remove only draft memberships
rebuild projection/audit/commit
commands.rule: generated/exported communication draft never locks membership

commands.name: AcceptFaultTagSubmission
steps: inside UoW require nonempty draft memberships and every RMA return obligation still open with exact selected unit/consequence
revalidate no obligation or unit is active in another submitted membership
if pickup require exactly one pickup-origin Dispatch Location and snapshot effective name/address/context
insert receipt/submission_accepted event and immutable Fault Tag submission snapshot + one immutable membership snapshot per current member
append submitted event/current row for each membership and mark active_submitted=1
rebuild Fault Tag/RMA/attention projections, audit exact members and commit
rules: first submission is authority only after manual confirmation or reviewed indexed sent evidence
master data later changes never rewrite snapshot

commands.name: CorrectFalseFaultTagSubmission
steps: inside UoW prove target is current submission authority and no accepted warehouse/logistics/real-send evidence contradicts correction
insert receipt/submission_corrected_false event targeting original
append targeted membership corrections to deactivate submitted status while preserving old snapshots/events
restore current projection=draft and draft editing
audit/commit
commands.rule: same tag may return to Draft only for false-event correction; actual submitted membership is never edited

commands.name: RecordWarehouseReceipt
steps: inside one UoW preflight every target must be submitted_awaiting_receipt and exact obligation/unit still correspond
insert receipt and optional inventory_lifecycle_batch
append one warehouse_received membership event per target
rebuild each membership/Fault Tag/RMA projection; leave return obligation open
audit per-target results and commit
rules: receipt does not close RMA obligation

commands.name: RecordWarehouseFinalDecision
input: decision accepted|rejected per compatible bulk intent
steps: inside UoW require explicit final confirmation and each target in warehouse_received/current final-decision-eligible state
insert receipt and batch when multi-target
append one accepted/rejected event per membership
accepted: append RMA return close event and set obligation closed_accepted; rejected: keep/reopen exact obligation open and clear active submitted membership
rebuild membership/Fault Tag/RMA/attention projections
audit independent results and commit
rules: communication can only propose final decision; it never satisfies explicit confirmation
rejected membership remains unresolved and may enter later resend

commands.name: CreateFaultTagReplacement
steps: outside lock preview material difference and revalidate replacement membership eligibility against current obligations/units
inside UoW prove predecessor was actually submitted, has no correction successor and new lineage would remain acyclic
insert receipt; allocate new Fault Tag/FT handle and new membership identities
append predecessor superseded event, create corrects_replaces lineage, create replacement draft with revalidated selected memberships
rebuild predecessor/successor projections/audit/commit
rules: replacement itself must later be submitted explicitly

commands.name: CreateFaultTagResend
steps: outside lock verify selected obligations are open because of genuine prior rejection and selected return units remain current
inside UoW revalidate no contradictory active submitted membership and no resend predecessor conflict for each selected scope
insert receipt; allocate new Fault Tag/FT handle/new membership identities; create resend_of lineage
leave predecessor lifecycle/history unchanged; create resend as Draft
audit/commit
rules: resend is new operational history, not correction/reopening predecessor
one predecessor may support separately scoped resend attempts only for disjoint unresolved obligations

commands.name: ArchiveOrRestoreFaultTag
steps: inside UoW revalidate archive cannot conceal unresolved action-required obligations from forced-visible surfaces
insert receipt/lifecycle event
rebuild archive presentation projection/audit/commit
commands.rule: archive never changes memberships, obligations, lineage or warehouse facts
